## Rows this PR addresses

The ten `@objectstack/cli` integration files of the per-case CLI spawn family (`test/generate-refuses-*.test.ts` and the five named `test/build-*.test.ts`). Reading used: the per-file list of shard-timings refresh run `40275747937` (PR #25960, the newest refresh with a per-file list; it was not merged, and PR #26089 used the same list for the spec/lint rows). The card's own table (run `38340176409`) is older and lower.

Budget = slowest CI reading x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s (the grammar `readTestBudget` in `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` enforces; all ten lines parse through it). Pin: the next refresh lists none of these ten in its over-budget table; each appears under "Held to the budget it declares" instead, and is listed again only if a run reads it over its own budget.

## Why a declared budget, not a cheaper test

The order's hypothesis was a per-case boot that one `beforeAll` could share. Measured, it does not hold here:

- **The cost is the spawn floor, not the cases.** One `tsx bin/run-dev.js` spawn costs 8.2 to 8.5 s locally, and `os --version` alone costs 8.4 to 8.8 s: the source entry has oclif import all 72 command modules through tsx on every start, because no `oclif.manifest.json` exists. Every file's local wall is its spawn count x 8.5 to 9.5 s (for example 7 spawns, 65 s; 3 spawns, 25 s).
- **There is nothing to share.** The five `generate-refuses-*` files already run all their spawns in one `beforeAll`. Every spawn in all ten files is a different argv or a different fixture: each one is a single-cause case (a refusal, its dry-run form, the neighbouring layer's verdict, or a control). Cutting one removes a case.
- So no file with even one spawn fits the 10 s line without changing the spawn entry, which the claim leaves out. These files are exactly the class ruling record 6181973363 letter B names ("spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture"). Each now carries its one-line `// test-budget:` header, as eleven other cli spawn files already do.
- Concurrency inside a file was looked at and not taken. Two parallel spawns cost the same 9.3 s as one, but four take 17.5 s and seven take 28.9 s on this 4-core box. That is packing, not less work, which is the reason `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` records for rejecting `maxWorkers: 4`.

## The lever that would make these budgets fall (a decision, not taken here)

Measured on this tree, with an `oclif.manifest.json` written into `packages/cli` for the probe and removed afterwards (`git status` clean): `tsx bin/run-dev.js generate object order_line --dry-run` drops from 8.2 to 8.5 s to **2.0 to 2.3 s**, with byte-identical output (1412 bytes) and the same exit code. `--version` drops to 0.4 s. A refusal case (`generate object class`) still exits 1 in 2.2 s. Applied to this family, local wall would fall from about 520 s to about 130 s. It is reported to the seat as an open decision because it changes the spawn shape these files document.

## Proof

- Diff: 10 files, +10 lines, each a header comment at line 2. No case, assertion, timeout, tier or project changes.
- Cases still isolated: shuffled run at `179c8078a`, `pnpm exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 --sequence.shuffle --sequence.seed=23181` + the 10 files: Test Files 10 passed (10), Tests 91 passed (91), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Wall before: the table's three local runs, under `os-verify-lock`, `--project integration --maxWorkers=2`, the default reporter's per-file module line (the number CI's per-file timings read). The after wall is the same tree's behaviour (comment-only diff), so it was not re-run three times; the shuffled run above is the after reading.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `179c8078a`: 55 commands, all exit 0 (two first exited 3 on prerequisites: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on a shallow clone, fixed by fetching `621a4876`; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` on eight unbuilt packages, fixed by building them). `--ran`: "55 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/cli`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Three spawns repeat across files with the same argv in an empty project: `os g object class` (in `unimportable-alias`, `unparseable-name`, `name-outside-charset`), `os g object order-line` (in `unimportable-alias`, `name-outside-charset`) and `os g object order_line` (in `unparseable-name`, `name-outside-charset`). Each file asserts a different layer's wording on its copy, so they are not removed here. Folding them is about 4 spawns (about 35 s per run) and a cross-file reshuffle of the #16726, #16541 and #17410 layer pins.
